censoring_rule: Hazard rows are censored when no nonzero mid change is observed inside the cutoff window: the window runs past the last bar before any move, the window up to the first move touches an unobserved bar, or a complete observed window holds no move. A move observed before the last bar labels the row even when the cutoff window itself is incomplete. Censored rows are reported per reason.
notes: The hazard target is the waiting time to the first nonzero mid change, with up and down moves as competing events. It is a separate target from P1's binary/three-class direction labels; no hazard number is compared against a direction accuracy or baseline.
Every row carries valid t_observe <= t_decision <= t_outcome, or explicit censoring with a recorded reason. No outcome window crosses a feed gap.
Calibration compares the fitted survival exp(-lambda_total * t) against a Kaplan-Meier estimate on held-out rows at each horizon.
selection_rule: No test outcome is used for parameter selection. The constant-hazard baseline has no tuned parameters and each walk-forward fold fits on its train rows only with a purge of one cutoff length. Every session is reported.
